summary: Iteration 5 frontend-only verification of CoinArchive. All 15 review items PASS: fixed Berlin Wall link, new /submit form + success state, navbar + mobile + contribute CTAs route to /submit, new /about /contact /privacy /imprint pages, /learn/:slug articles, global 404 catch-all (incl. /learn/nonexistent), all footer column links with footer-link-* testids, per-route document.title for /coins /countries /series /learn /mint-marks /submit /about + Berlin Wall + home default, Tab-once focuses ca-skip-link, EN/DE toggle on /submit changes 'Coin title' to 'Münzname' and German success view works. Mobile 390x844: /submit form and 404 page render with no horizontal overflow, mobile menu Submit button navigates to /submit. Regression on /, /coins, /coins/germany-2019-berlin-wall, /countries, /countries/de, /series, /series/german-federal-states, /learn, /mint-marks: all load with correct titles and zero page errors.
action_items: MINOR (non-blocking): Mobile menu primary 'Submit Coin' button (Navbar.jsx line 131) lacks a data-testid attribute. It functions correctly (verified via role+name) but adding e.g. data-testid='nav-mobile-cta-submit' would align with the project's testability standard.
critical_code_review_comments: Dev-mode console hydration warnings ('<span> cannot be a child of <option>') are caused by the visual-editor tooling injecting wrapper <span data-ve-dynamic> nodes inside <option> elements at runtime — NOT by the source code (SubmitPage.jsx and CoinsListing.jsx render plain expressions inside <option>). No action needed in app code; this is a dev-instrumentation artifact and will not appear in production builds.
useDocumentTitle restores prev title on unmount which is fine, but note that when navigating between routes the brief flicker order is acceptable here.
SubmitPage submission is mock-only (client-side setSubmitted(true)) as confirmed in the request — clearly documented in code comment.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 closed all HIGH-priority audit items. Only optional improvement: add data-testid to mobile-menu Submit CTA in Navbar.jsx line 131 (currently identified by text only). No other regressions observed. Public preview URL: https://european-mint-museum.preview.emergentagent.com (from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL).
